UN Women

Gender equality and the empowerment of women

Hana Al-Bakri

President of UN Women

hanaalbakri7@gmail.com

Letter from the President

Honorable Delegates,

It is with great excitement and pride that I welcome you to UN Women at ASRIYYAMUN’26. My name is Hana Al-Bakri, and I am honoured to serve as the President of this committee. Your presence here reflects not only academic dedication, but also a genuine commitment to justice, equality, and meaningful global change.

This year’s conference theme, “Turn The Tide,” could not be more relevant to the work of UN Women. Across the world, gender roles, power structures, and social norms are being challenged and redefined. While progress has been made, women and girls continue to face systemic barriers, discrimination, and violence — especially in times of conflict and political instability. UN Women stands at the heart of these shifting realities, where advocacy, accountability, and action must move together.

As delegates of UN Women, you are expected to uphold the values of the United Nations while engaging in debate that is respectful, thoughtful, and impactful. This committee is a space where powerful ideas are welcomed, difficult conversations are encouraged, and meaningful solutions are built through collaboration.

Once again, welcome to ASRIYYAMUN’26. In a world of shifting sands, UN Women remains a platform where resilience meets reform, and where dialogue can shape a more equal future. I look forward to an inspiring, empowering, and unforgettable conference with all of you.

Sincerely, Hana Al-Bakri President of UN Women
